LanguageData.RimMT_SettingsIntro: Compatibility-first performance and load balancing for RimWorld 1.5.
LanguageData.RimMT_AdaptiveBurstDesc: Detects tick spikes and temporarily defers background worker jobs so high-priority work gets the CPU first.
LanguageData.RimMT_HotPathDiagnostics: Profile PathFinder and JobGiver hot paths
LanguageData.RimMT_HotPathDiagnosticsDesc: Records call counts, average time, approximate P95 and maximum spikes for PathFinder and JobGiver.
LanguageData.RimMT_TextCacheDesc: Caches repeated UI text size/height calculations. Low risk; automatically disabled if another mod patches the same methods.
LanguageData.RimMT_OverlayCacheDesc: Avoids scanning every overlay-capable Thing every rendered frame while the camera is stationary. Draw calls remain on the main thread.
LanguageData.RimMT_PathSnapshotWorkerDesc: Copies an immutable PathGrid snapshot on the main thread and runs independent worker A*. V0.4.3.2 fixes path reconstruction result copying and validates found-state parity, path legality, endpoints, snapshot-relative cost, node-count delta and geometry divergence. Vanilla PawnPath remains authoritative.
LanguageData.RimMT_ReachNoCacheDesc: Reuses only recent false reachability results for cell targets. Old entries are invalidated when the path grid topology changes.
LanguageData.RimMT_LogReport: Log current runtime compatibility / performance report
